title: House Hold’em

Uniformly reduce the ENTIRE existing title-and-cards-and-chips composition to 80% of its current size, centered in the same true 2:1 landscape canvas. initialGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium casino catalogue title-card illustration.
Primary request: one finished, beautiful House Hold’em title card, with a distinctive dealer-versus-player table composition.
Scene/backdrop: rich emerald felt with deep teal shadows, restrained warm antique-gold table trim and a softly darkened forest-green perimeter. Polished casino collection identity.
Subject: an orderly miniature dealer-versus-player arrangement seen from a slightly elevated oblique angle. At the back, exactly two overlapping face-down blue cards with elegant gold geometric backs, no logo. Across the middle, a straight row of exactly five small ivory community cards: 3 hearts, 5 clubs, 7 diamonds, 9 spades, 2 hearts. At the front, a separate slightly overlapping pair of face-up aces, ace of hearts and ace of clubs. All face-up cards use a simple modern deck: one large central suit symbol per card and small matching rank/suit corner indices, NEVER repeated pip patterns. A few restrained red and charcoal chips sit alongside the front pair; no sprawling pot.
Style/medium: premium professionally illustrated game key art, subtly painterly felt and ivory surfaces, crisp silhouettes, controlled dimensional highlights, tasteful restrained gold. No people or portraits.
Composition/framing: true wide 2:1 canvas. The table-card arrangement occupies one side of the central composition and the large two-line title balances it on the other side, without overlap. Clearly show separate dealer pair, five-card row, and player pair, not a generic fan. Keep the complete title and all essential cards inside x=15% to 85%, y=20% to 80%, with generous quiet empty felt margins on all sides. Do not fill the canvas with props. Title must read clearly at 256x128.
Text (verbatim): "House Hold’em". Exactly these words once in large elegant gold serif type, House above Hold’em. Preserve the curly apostrophe. No other wording.
Constraints: no game interface, buttons, betting labels, payout claims, slogans, brand marks, watermark, currency, human characters, court portraits, palace/castle or unrelated symbolic props. Opaque background. One image only.
